eligibility.quote:
Need to be a bit careful here, because we have no control over how the user
 * is calling this - they may be calling from different threads (this is so for
 * kobuki_node), so we mutex protect it here rather than relying on the user
 * to do so above.

Failed condition class 'other' agreed: unstated thread-safety of the command API has no dedicated class, and exclusive_resource_conflict does not fit because the serial port is internal to kobuki_driver, not an interaction element between the two units. Implicated elements agreed: the four are exactly the callback-reached entries that synchronously write serial from the caller's thread at 32388d7 — setLed/setDigitalOutput/playSoundSequence via sendCommand (kobuki.cpp:314-331 -> :384) and disable via sendBaseControlCommand (:407-413 -> :362); the excluded entries do not write serial at this revision (setBaseControl :333-336 only calls 'diff_drive.velocityCommands(linear_velocity, angular_velocity);', resetOdometry :294-297 only 'diff_drive.reset(inertia.data.angle);', enable :401-405 only sets is_enabled), which matches the issue's 'Serial writes unprotected' scope. Borderline: the fix's mutex comment is broader ('protection against the user calling the command functions from multiple threads'), so adding api:setBaseControl would also be defensible given its diff_drive state race with the spin thread (:345 reads 'diff_drive.velocityCommands()'), which the SetVelocityControl rerouting incidentally serializes; I judge the spec's scoping a correct, code-grounded reading, not an error. Loudness unknown / detection_stage unknown agreed: the complete source record is the two-sentence issue body plus 'Done.' — no run, no diagnostic, no observed effect; the quoted body itself shows only an exposure statement and fix intent. 'command_mutex.unlock();' in sendCommand, and sendBaseControlCommand's body replaced by 'sendCommand(Command::SetVelocityControl(velocity_commands[0], velocity_commands[1]));' so the streaming thread takes the same lock; commit also bundles unrelated work (sig_raw_data_command debug signal + kobuki_node publisher in kobuki_node files, debugStream removal, laptop battery monitor disabled), consistent with the spec's units note that 03660af edits kobuki_node in ways unrelated to the race.
